datasets.title: Mali Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Mali Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mali_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments and compiled Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data across Mali administrative areas throughout 2021. The spatial classifications were standardized into geographic formats (GeoJSON/KML) representing food insecurity phases as a proxy indicator of drought-related food security impacts.
